# Verdent

> > Verdent is an AI-native development platform enabling parallel, focused software workflows with Claude Code, MCP integration, and multi-agent orchestration.

Verdent provides comprehensive guides, comparisons, and best practices for AI-powered development tools including Claude Skills, Claude Code, and integration with platforms like Vertex AI, GitHub, and VS Code. The platform focuses on workflow automation, agent-based development, and developer productivity through AI-native approaches.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- Claude Skills
- Anthropic AI
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- AI coding agents
- Workflow automation
- VS Code integration
- GitHub worktree
- Multi-agent orchestration
- Developer productivity
- Vertex AI
- Gemini 3.1 Pro
- AI-native development
- Agent Skills (SKILL.md)
- Terminal-based AI tools
